```{r}
source("LoadDat.R")
plot_spp <- function(df) {
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(sp_english, pct_change_median)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    # geom_line(aes(group = sp_english), alpha = 0.2)
    geom_pointrange(
      aes(
        ymin = pct_change_qlow,
        ymax = pct_change_qhigh,
        # colour = model_name
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
    labs(y = "Median % Change between atlas 2 and 3", x = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~group)
}
```

```{r}


gen_dist <- function(spp_code, model_name) {
  # browser()
  f_ <- list.files(
    glue::glue(
      "C:/Users/HOped/OneDrive - EC-EC/Projects/Atlas-3/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/rasters_{model_name}/"
    ),
    glue::glue("^{spp_code}_a\\d.tif"),
    full.names = T
  )
  if (length(f_) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  r <- terra::rast(f_)

  cent_ <- r |>
    terra::centroids(weighted = T)
  cents_sf <-
    cent_ |>
    mutate(
      lyr = names(r),
      atlas = rep(str_extract(f_, "a2|a3"), each = 2),
      species = spp_code
    ) |>
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(r), remove = F) |>
    filter(lyr == "mu_q50") |>
    mutate(model_name = model_name)

  dist_move <- cents_sf |>
    st_transform(3161) %>%
    st_distance(.[1, ], .[2, ]) |>
    units::set_units('km') %>%
    .[2, 1]

  azimuth_rad <- st_transform(cents_sf, 4326) |> lwgeom::st_geod_azimuth()
  azimuth_deg <- units::set_units(azimuth_rad, "degrees")

  list(
    change = tibble(
      species = spp_code,
      model_name = model_name,
      change_deg = azimuth_deg,
      change_rad = azimuth_rad,
      change_dist_km = dist_move
    ),
    centroids = cents_sf
  )
}

all_mods <-
  map(
    c( "PC_ARU_CL_SS"),
    ~ {
      rast_og <- list.files(
        glue::glue(
          "C:/Users/HOped/OneDrive - EC-EC/Projects/Atlas-3/Ontario_BBA3_draft5/data_clean/model_output/rasters_{.x}/"
        ),
        "_a\\d.tif"
      )

      tibble(
        model_name = .x,
        spp_code = str_remove_all(rast_og, "_(a2|a3).tif") |> unique()
      )
    }
  ) |>
  list_rbind()

all_spp_res <-read_rds( "..RAW_DATA/Raw_species_res_distance_final.rds")

# gen_dist("blue_winged_warbler", "PC_ARU")

all_dists <- all_spp_res |> transpose() |> pluck("change") |> list_rbind() |> 
  mutate(abs_change =abs(units::drop_units(change_deg)),
  abs_dist =  abs(units::drop_units(change_dist_km))) |> 
    left_join(d_change[d_change$Region_Number=='province',], by = join_by( species==sp_file)) |> 
    mutate(delta_x = sin(change_rad)* change_dist_km,
    delta_y = cos(change_rad)* change_dist_km) 
all_centroids <- all_spp_res |>
  transpose() |>
  pluck("centroids") |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
d_change_gr

library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
set_cmdstan_path("//wsl$/ECCC-WSL-UBUNTU-24/home/dhope/.cmdstan/cmdstan-2.40.0")
priors <- c(prior(normal(0,50), class = Intercept),
            prior(cauchy(0,50), class = sd))

d_mod <- d_change_gr |> 
  filter(region_type =='province' & model_name == "Spatial model")

m.brm <- brms::brm(pct_change_mean|se(pct_change_se) ~ 1 +(1|group),
             data =d_mod,
             prior = priors,cores = 4,
             iter = 4000, backend = 'cmdstanr')
  m.brm
```
$$ \begin{eqnarray} \text{d}_i & \sim & \text{Normal}(\theta_i, \sigma_i = \text{se}_i) \\ \theta_i & \sim & \text{Normal} (\mu, \tau) \\ \mu & \sim & \text{Normal} (0, 1) \\ \tau & \sim & \text{HalfCauchy} (0, 1) \end{eqnarray} $$

```{r}
library(tidybayes)

m.brm %>%
  spread_draws(b_Intercept, r_group[group,]) %>%
  # add the grand mean to the group-specific deviations
  mutate(mu =  r_group +b_Intercept) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(group = str_replace_all(group, "[.]", " ")) %>% 

  # plot
  ggplot(aes(x = mu, y = reorder(group, mu))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept =0, color = "grey", size = 1, linetype=2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(m.brm)[1, 1], color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(m.brm)[1, 3:4], color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  stat_halfeye(.width = .95, size = 2/3) +
  labs(x = expression(italic("Provincial change from Atlas 2")),
       y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

```{r}

gen_mod_forest <- function(df,gr, bcr=NULL){
  if(is.null(bcr)){
    d <- df[df$group==gr,] 
    xlab_ <- expression(italic("Provincial % change from Atlas 2"))
  } else{
    d <- filter(df, group==gr & Region_Name == bcr)
    xlab_ <- glue::glue("% change from Atlas 2 in {bcr}")
  }
  ggplot(d,aes(x = pct_change_median, y = reorder(english_common_name, pct_change_median))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept =0, color = "grey", size = 1, linetype=2) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(m.brm)[1, 1], color = "black", size = 1) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = fixef(m.brm)[1, 3:4], color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = pct_change_qlow, xmax = pct_change_qhigh)) +
  labs(x = xlab_,
       y = NULL, title = paste0(c(gr, bcr), collapse = " - ")) +
  theme(panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(hjust = 0))
}
```

```{r}

    
gen_plt <- function(mod, reg=T){

  dat <- d_change_gr |>
  mutate(pct_change_se=(pct_change_qhigh-pct_change_mean)/qnorm(ci_level)) |> 
  select(model_name, sp_english,Region_Name,fc_region, group, starts_with('pct')) |> 
  filter(!is.na(pct_change_mean)) %>% {
    if(isFALSE(reg)){
      filter(.,Region_Name=="Province-wide" & model_name==mod)
    } else{
        filter(.,Region_Name!="Province-wide" & model_name==mod)
      }
    } |>  
    filter(group!="None") |> 
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mu = mean(pct_change_mean),
    v_w = (sum(pct_change_se**2)/n),
    v_b = sum((pct_change_mean-mu)**2)/(n-1),
    v_total = v_w + v_b + v_b/n,
    se_pooled = sqrt(v_total),
    ci_size = se_pooled * qnorm(0.975),
    Wald_pooled = mu**2/v_total,
    lambda = (v_b + (v_b/n))/v_total,
    r = lambda / (1-lambda),
    df_old = (n-1) * (1+1/r)**2,
    # df_obs = sum(n_hex_used),
    t_df = dt(0.975, df_old),
    ci_pooled_t = se_pooled *t_df,
    .by = c(model_name,group,Region_Name,fc_region)
  ) |> filter(n>1)
  
  plt_ <- dat |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mu, y = group, colour = Region_Name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept =0, color = "grey", linewidth = 1, linetype=2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mu-ci_pooled_t, xmax = mu+ci_pooled_t), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, orientation = 'y')) +
  labs(x = expression(italic("Provincial % change from Atlas 2")),
       y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(hjust = 0)) +
  facet_grid(~model_name, scales = 'free')
  
  list(plot = plt_, data = dat)
}
plot_comb_se <- 
map(unique(d_change_gr$model_name), gen_plt)
```
